description: Somerville City Councilor Ben Ewen-Campen launches campaign for State Representative in the 27th Middlesex District Five-term Councilor cites Somerville's progressive track record as model for Beacon Hill SOMERVILLE, Mass., March 4, 2026 — Somerville Ward 3 City Councilor Ben Ewen-Campen today
